messages:
alex.k: Heads-up — in console quick-switch preview I'm seeing rows from the previous workspace for a couple seconds after switching. Noted on prod: customer A's dashboard showed B's rows briefly. :eyes:

maria.s: Ugh. Any repro steps? Is this the saved-search preview or the quick nav 'peek'?

alex.k: Quick-nav peek (the dropdown preview). Repro: 1) open workspace A -> open projects dashboard, 2) use quick-switch to B (CMD+K) -> peek opens while route changes -> preview shows A's rows for ~1.5-2s then corrects.

alex.k: I grabbed console logs and network:
```
GET /api/preview?workspace=B 200 - response cachedFrom=memory cacheKey=preview:workspace:A:projects
info: cacheHit tenant=workspace:A route=/api/preview
```

alex.k: So preview request is firing but server returns a cached response that was keyed incorrectly (A instead of B).

devin.p: That looks like a cache key composition bug. Did we recently change the preview handler?

sid.r: We shipped the prefetch/route-affinity PR last week that changed header usage to X-Route-Affinity and moved tenant header downstream. Possible the preview cache middleware uses old header name or falls back to session org id.

jess.t: Related: I rolled out the preview caching optimization 3 days ago (reduced TTL to 30s + memory cache). Might be our key includes userId but not workspaceId in some code paths.

maria.s: If it's memory cache on the console server, it might be keyed by request.url only. Quick-switch sends the preview query param but the client preloads with workspace hidden in cookie sometimes -> mismatch.

alex.k: Exact stack trace from server when it constructed key:
```
at PreviewMiddleware.buildKey (preview/middleware.ts:48)
return `preview:${req.session.orgId || req.query.from || 'unknown'}:${routeName}`
```

alex.k: So it falls back to req.query.from which client doesn't set during quick-switch. That explains it.

devin.p: OK, fix is to prefer explicit X-Org header and include req.header('x-org') first. Also make key include workspaceId param (req.query.workspace).

sid.r: Quick mitigation: disable memory cache for preview for canary users, revert TTL change. We can push a small hotfix to guard buildKey to throw if orgId missing so it doesn't serve stale data.

jess.t: Rolling a canary rollback now for the preview optimization — deploy-bot will post release id.

deploy-bot: deploy started: preview-optimize v1.6.3 -> canary cluster. ID: dpl-2026-03-20-88.

maria.s: Can someone own the postmortem? We need clear note for console docs + alerts: telemetry should emit "preview.cache.mismatch" when cache key falls back.

alex.k: I'll own the PM. Action items: 1) devin to patch buildKey to prefer header + include workspace param (ETA 2h). 2) sid to flip memory cache off for preview on canary (done by ops, ETA 30m). 3) jess to rollback preview optimize if canary shows issues (on watch). 4) alex to write postmortem and add telemetry signal.

devin.p: I'll open PR now and ping for review.

sid.r: Ops: turning off memory cache on canary now. :white_check_mark:

jess.t: Watching canary dashboards — if preview 500s or latency spikes >50ms, rollback.

alex.k: Thanks all. We'll keep thread updated. If you see cross-workspace flashes in other areas (search, saved views) dump logs here.

maria.s: Adding follow-up to run a grep of all .buildKey usages across console services and ensure workspace/org are always part of the key.

devin.p: PR: https://stash.redwood/preview/fix/buildkey (WIP)

jess.t: FYI — putting an alert on console-telemetry for any cache hit where headerOrg != sessionOrg.

alex.k: Great. Closing for now, will reopen if canary shows the issue persists. :thumbsup:
